title: Role
description:
A Role is the product-layer projection of an Operational Position AND the RBAC role consumed by product/api auth middleware and product/ui permission guards. Like every Product Core primitive it is DERIVED, never hand-authored — the product-core-materializer projects it from the operational People primitives.

The `position` mapping names the Operational Position it projects (defaults to `name`). Role no longer carries an inline `scope` — per-scope authorization is expressed as `Permission` nodes (`principal + role + scope`), where `scope` is a namespaced entity reference. The former derived `permissions[]` rollup is superseded by the Permission junction.

name.description: The PascalCase name of the role.

position.description: The Operational Position this product role projects. Defaults to matching `name` when omitted.
